job.question: In the Boston Retirement System's investment consulting services proposal questionnaire (Attachment 3), how many current public fund client references must be listed, and what minimum asset size must those clients have?
job.expected_facts: Up to 10 current public fund clients with assets greater than $1 billion for whom similar work was performed, giving name, contact, telephone number, asset values, number of years the client has retained the firm and the service used.
job.acceptance: Accept up to ten / no more than ten and >$1bn. Contact-detail fields and similar-work context are supplementary; exactly ten or at least $1bn is not equivalent.

reviews.reason: This is an Illinois Teachers’ Retirement System RFP with a questionnaire in Appendix D, not the Boston Retirement System’s Attachment 3. Its reference requests do not state a limit of up to ten current public fund clients with assets greater than $1 billion.
